gloss: prior to; before; the other day; recently

definitions.gloss: prior to; before; in advance of
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that something happens before or in preparation for another event. Often takes the form ～に先立って.

definitions.gloss: the other day; recently; a few days ago
definitions.explanation: Refers to something that happened in the recent past. A slightly formal alternative to この間.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}って⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: To hand out materials prior to the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}って、⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Prior to the opening, there was a greeting from the chairman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}って、⟦{入念|にゅうねん}→入念：20208_nyuunen⟧な⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A thorough rehearsal was conducted prior to the actual performance.

examples.japanese: {先立|さきだ}ってお{話|はなし}した⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: Regarding the matter I mentioned the other day.

examples.japanese: {先立|さきだ}って⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{世話|せわ}→お世話：02506_osewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for your help the other day.

examples.japanese: {先立|さきだ}って⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しました→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the documents that arrived the other day.

notes:
Has two distinct uses as an adverb. In sense 1, it functions as a formal conjunction meaning 'prior to' and typically appears as ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}って. In sense 2, it is a slightly formal way of saying 'the other day.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}って: prior to ~; ahead of ~
- {先立|さきだ}って + past event: the other day; recently

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 1):
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: before ~ — everyday, less formal
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて: ahead of; pioneering — implies being first/early
- あらかじめ: in advance; beforehand

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 2):
- ⟦この{間|あいだ}→この間：01257_konoaida⟧: the other day — casual
- ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧: the other day — polite/formal
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ほど: recently — formal
